name: workflow_guard
title: Prevent workflow work-ahead in the edit guard
body: internal/guard decides edit permission from the DOT graph parsed by internal/workflow. Plan state-derived enforcement that permits source edits only in performer-owned states, so a named isolated performer may work during its own dispatch while the driving session stays denied. Edit-capable states must stay derived from the graph rather than matched by name. Do not edit source — produce the plan only.
acceptance: Edit-capable states are derived from the workflow DOT rather than hardcoded names.
Backlog, reviewer parks, terminal states, and the driving session during a dispatch all deny edits.
The exact dispatched performer may edit during its matching step.
Resolution failures deny closed with actionable recovery text.

expected_seams.test_hint: performing states come from agent= attributes on parsed nodes
matching Agent allowed, mismatched Agent denied
unknown state denies closed naming the recovery command
